body: Policy change by owner decision: Bun 1.3.14 is RETIRED as the test baseline; work on 1.4.1 until a newer release lands. Gates now run on C:/bun/bin/bun.exe (1.4.1) only, and the expected result is 0 fail - including the compiled-dashboard case, which only failed because 1.3.14 lacks the --asset flag that scripts.build uses. The recorded '283 pass / 1 fail' baseline is superseded by '284 pass / 0 fail on 1.4.1 with the dashboard client built' (build it first when src/dashboard/client/dist is missing). Agent briefs, the freeze doc baseline row, the verification protocol and plan section 16 have been updated to match. Nothing else changed: no source file was touched for this, and the archived 1.3.14 build stays in C:/bun/versions/ for archaeology only.
